name: Takanashi Tatsuya
source:
A first year student living alone in an apartment. Has quite a few friends, but there are no girls in his circle. It's not like he has something that makes him unpopular with the girls, but for them he is only an acquaintance.

He is kind but dense. He is not the type to notice women's hints and advances. 

Due to him living alone, he's quite responsible and could cook for himself. 

Because his predecessor transferred schools, he was named as the student council secretary. He's not a member of any club. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1206508]Getchu[/url]]
